cities.name: Budva
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fresh fish, grilled calamari, Mediterranean salads and local wines — perfect after beach or day trips along the coast. 🐟🍋🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Early swim or beach walk on Slovenska / Mogren beach → ☕ Breakfast at a seaside café.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore Budva’s Old Town — narrow stone streets, historic walls and charming architecture → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or local grilled dishes.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk the coastal promenade or head to a viewpoint above the old town for panorama of sea & rooftops.

Night: 🌃 Dinner by the sea, gelato or local wine; then enjoy nightlife — bars, live music or relaxed seaside strolls under starlight.

ideas: 🌼 Beachfront paths and coastal promenades awakening — good for walks and light swims.
🚶 Quiet Old Town exploration without summer crowds.
☀️ Pleasant weather for seafood lunches on terraces by the sea.
🏖️ Sun, sea and beach — perfect vacation days at the coast.
🍹 Evening drinks, seaside dinners and summer nightlife by the water.
🎶 Open‑air concerts or gatherings near the beach under warm nights.
🍁 Softer sun, calmer sea — nice for sunset walks and coastal photos.
🔥 Hearty seafood dishes and local wines after day trips.
📸 Old Town + sea under autumn light — scenic and peaceful.
🌬️ Breezy coastal walks, quiet beaches and mild weather compared to mountains.
🔥 Warm meals, cosy cafés — perfect for a calm winter getaway by the sea.
🛌 Low tourist traffic — peaceful stays and relaxed vibe in coastal town.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Buses connect Budva with other coastal towns and the capital — check schedules in advance.
🚶 Old Town and beachfront are walkable on foot — ideal za pešačenje.
🚗 Car or scooter rental useful for exploring nearby beaches and hidden bays.
🎫 During peak season, booking accommodations & transport early is recommended.

city_events.name: Budva Summer Beach Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Beach parties, music, seaside events and lively summer atmosphere on the Adriatic coast.

cities.name: Bar
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood, grilled fish, olive‑oil dishes, local salads and wines — Adriatic flavors in a historic port town. 🐟🍷🌿
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🚶 Walk along the old port and seaside harbour — enjoy sea breeze and historic atmosphere → ☕ Breakfast in a waterfront tavern.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Explore Old Town (Stari Bar) ruins or nearby olive groves and countryside → 🍽️ Lunch: local seafood or Mediterranean dish with olive oil and fresh veggies.

Sunset: 🌇 Harbour promenade or coastal cliff for sunset views over the Adriatic and mountains beyond.

Night: 🌙 Dinner by the sea, gentle coastal nightlife or quiet walk along harbour under moonlight — calm and relaxed coastal charm.

ideas: 🌸 Mild weather — great for walking along coast or visiting old town ruins.
🌿 Olive groves fresh with spring greenery — good for countryside strolls.
☀️ Outdoor meals by the sea with gentle early‑season sun.
🏖️ Sea swims, harbour walks and coastal relaxation.
🐠 Seafood lunches/dinners, fresh catch and Mediterranean dining by water.
🚤 Possibility of short boat trips along coast or nearby bays.
🍂 Olive harvest season — countryside looks scenic, quieter coast.
🥘 Warm meals, seafood & local produce with cooler weather and calm evenings.
📷 Coastal light under autumn sun — perfect for photos and peaceful stays.
🌫️ Misty coastline and quiet towns — tranquil mood for off‑season stays.
🔥 Cozy tavern dinners, local wine and warm meals after cold sea breeze.
🚶 Walking by sea cliffs or harbour under winter sky — calm and contemplative atmosphere.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Train station — main rail link connecting with inland and coastal towns.
🚍 Buses link Bar with nearby villages and coastal areas — check timetable offseason.
🚶 Town centre and harbour walkable — ideal bez auta.
🚗 Car/rental useful za istraživanje sela, vinograda i obližnjih plaža.

city_events.name: Bar Coastal Heritage Days
city_events.description: 🍷 Olive harvest events, seafood feasts, local gatherings and calm coastal culture.

cities.name: Ulcinj
interests: Sea & Island Trips (Sveti Stefan, Ada Bojana) 🚤
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, Mediterranean salads, fresh fish, grilled squid and local wines or rakija — ideal coastal tastes after beach or sea‑side activities. 🐙🍅🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Early swim or walk along Long Beach or Velika Plaža → 🥐 Breakfast in seaside tavern with sea view.

Afternoon: 🏝️ Boat trip to nearby islands or coastal excursions (Ada Bojana, small coves) → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or light Mediterranean meal.

Sunset: 🌇 Coastal promenade or beachfront cliff for sunset views over Adriatic — golden hour over water and horizon.

Night: 🌙 Dinner at beachside restaurant, local nightlife or calm seaside walk — relaxed coastal village atmosphere under stars.

ideas: 🌊 Gentle sea and mild weather — good for walks and quiet beaches before peak summer.
🚶 Explore old town quarter and coastal promenade without crowds.
🍷 Enjoy early-season seafood and coastal meals with sea breeze.
🏖️ Full summer — swimming, sunbathing and beach relaxation along long beaches.
🌙 Evening dinners by the sea, beach bars, coastal nightlife and warm Adriatic nights.
⛵ Boat rides or small excursions to nearby islands or hidden coves.
🍂 Softer sun and calmer sea — good for coastal walks and reflective stays.
🥘 Seafood or grilled dishes, local wines and calm seaside meals after day trips.
📷 Scenic photos — old town + sea + autumn light for peaceful memories.
🌬️ Fresh sea air and quiet coastline — peaceful off‑season retreat.
🔥 Cozy meals, local hospitality, calm town vibe away from summer crowds.
🚶 Coastal walks under winter sky — introspective and serene atmosphere.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses connect Ulcinj with other coastal towns and inland areas — korisno za jednodnevne izlete.
🚶 Old quarter, beachfront and town center walkable — odlična za pešake.
🚤 For island trips or coastal excursions — rent boat or join local tours (letnja sezona).
🎯 Plan unapred prevoz u van‑sezoni — redovi mogu biti ređi.

city_events.name: Ulcinj Summer Beach Fest
city_events.description: 🌅 Beach parties, coastal dinners, music and relaxed seaside holiday vibe by the Adriatic.

cities.name: Nikšić
cities.local_food_tip: Hearty dishes — stews, meat, local cheeses, bread and homemade wine — ideal after hikes or countryside adventures. 🍲🥖🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Hike or walk nearby hills, visit Lake Slano or rivers for fresh air and panoramic views → ☕ Breakfast in local bakery.

Afternoon: 🚶 Explore town centre, visit local landmarks and countryside villages nearby → 🍽️ Lunch: traditional Montenegrin comfort meal with local produce.

Sunset: 🌇 Hill or lake viewpoint for sunset over mountains and water — perfect for photos or peaceful reflection.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in town tavern or countryside inn, home‑style food and calm evening away from tourist bustle.

ideas: 🌿 Hills and valleys turn green — great za planinarenje i prirodu.
🚶 Quiet countryside walks, few turisti, mir i svež vazduh.
🍷 Lokalne vina i domaća jela u rustičnim tavernama.
🥾 Planinarenje, izleti van gužve, jezera ili reke za osveženje.
🍲 Teža jela i domaći specijaliteti posle aktivnog dana.
🌌 Noći u prirodi, zvuci tišine i čist planinski vazduh.
🍂 Zlatne boje šuma i livada — idealno za šetnje i foto‑izlete.
🔥 Hearty jela i domaća vina — sezona berbe i toplih ukusa.
📸 Panorama planina + jezera + dolina pod jesenskim svetlom — lepa za uspomene.
🌨️ Mir, zima, planinska atmosfera i tišina — beg iz gradske vreve.
🔥 Kamin, domaće jelo, vino i tiha noć u planinskoj kući ili taverni.
❄️ Hladne šetnje, svež vazduh, priroda — drugačija vrsta odmora.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regionalni autobusi povezuju grad sa okolnim selima i prirodnim spotovima — proveri red vožnje.
🚶 Centar grada je pogodan za pešačenje — lako se krećeš pješice.
🚗 Auto ili motor‑scooter idealan za istraživanje okolnih planina, jezera i sela.
🥾 Pripremi dobru opremu za prirodu — patike, voda, mapa, vreme zna brzo da se menja u planinama.

city_events.name: Nikšić Nature & Rural Festival
city_events.description: 🌲 Izleti, lokalna jela, folklor, priroda i autentično planinsko iskustvo.

cities.name: Cetinje
cities.local_food_tip: Mountain herbs, cheeses, traditional stews, local wines or brandy — domaća jela sa planinskim ukusom. 🧀🍷🍲
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Walk through historic old town — old mansions, museums and monuments of Montenegrin past → ☕ Traditional breakfast in a local kafana.

Afternoon: 🚶 Trip to nearby mountains or national park (Lovćen) for panoramic views, nature and hiking → 🍽️ Lunch: hearty mountain‑style meal.

Sunset: 🌇 View from hilltops or Lovćen passes — sunset over mountains, valleys and old town — spektakularan pogled.

Night: 🌙 Dinner in traditional inn, local folk music or quiet cultural evening — spoj istorije, tradicije i planinske tišine.

ideas: 🌿 Svež planinski vazduh i zelenilo — idealno za razgledavanje i šetnje.
🎭 Posete muzejima i kulturnim znamenitostima u prijatnom vremenu.
🥘 Domaća jela i planinska hrana u seoskim kafanama.
🏞️ Planinske šetnje, visoke temperature u dolini, osveženje u planinskoj klimi.
🍷 Kombinacija istorije, prirode i domaće kuhinje — miran i ispunjen odmor.
🌌 Noći ispod zvezda, tišina i čist vazduh — idealno za beg od gužve.
🍁 Jesenja šuma i planinska svetlost — savršeni za šetnje i fotografije.
🔥 Topla jela, domaća hrana i vino nakon dan proveden u prirodi.
🏯 Kulturne posete — muzeji, istorija i lokalne priče u grejanim prostorima.
❄️ Planinska tišina, sneg ili magla — jedinstven ambijent za zimske šetnje.
🔥 Kamin, domaći ručak, rakija i tradicionalna hrana za planinski duh.
🚶 Šetnje kroz istorijske ulice i planinske staze — mir i mirnoća bez sezone.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Autobusi povezuju Cetinje sa obalnim i planinskim delovima — zgodno za jednodnevne izlete.
🚶 Centar i stari deo grada su pregledni i pogodeni za pešačenje.
🚗 Auto ili kombi je koristan za planinske predele, vrhove i manje poznate delove okoline.
🎒 Pripremi se za planinsku klimu — slojevita odeća, dobra obuća i fleksibilan plan.

city_events.name: Cetinje Heritage & Mountain Days
city_events.description: 🏛️ Kulturne ture, planinske izlete, istorija i tradicija u jednom — autentično crnogorsko iskustvo.
